import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] gridA = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[12][12];
    static int sizeN, maxT;
    static boolean[][][][][] visitedDP = new boolean[70][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][][][] reachable = new boolean[12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] timeMap = new int[12][12];

    static void exploreDP(int tStep, int x, int y, int x0, int y0) {
        if (maxT >= 70 || x < 0 || x >= sizeN || y < 0 || y >= sizeN)
            return;
        if (gridA[x][y] < '0' || gridA[x][y] > '9')
            return;
        if (tStep > maxT + 1)
            return;
        if (visitedDP[tStep][x][y][x0][y0])
            return;
        if (timeMap[x][y] != 0 && tStep > timeMap[x][y])
            return;
        if (timeMap[x][y] == tStep && (gridB[x][y] > '9' || gridB[x][y] <= '0'))
            return;
        visitedDP[tStep][x][y][x0][y0] = true;

        if (tStep < timeMap[x][y]) {
            exploreDP(tStep + 1, x, y, x0, y0);
            exploreDP(tStep + 1, x + 1, y, x0, y0);
            exploreDP(tStep + 1, x - 1, y, x0, y0);
            exploreDP(tStep + 1, x, y + 1, x0, y0);
            exploreDP(tStep + 1, x, y - 1, x0, y0);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        sizeN = n;
        maxT = t;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                gridA[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                gridB[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        int[][] timeMap = new int[n][n];
        for (int[] row : timeMap)
            Arrays.fill(row, -1);

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    timeMap[i][j] = 0;
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                }

        int[] di = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dj = {0, -1, 0, 1};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int x = p[0], y = p[1];
            if (timeMap[x][y] >= t) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ni = x + di[d], nj = y + dj[d];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n && gridA[ni][nj] >= '0' && gridA[ni][nj] <= '9' && timeMap[ni][nj] == -1) {
                    timeMap[ni][nj] = timeMap[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (timeMap[i][j] == -1)
                    timeMap[i][j] = t;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (gridA[i][j] >= '0' && gridA[i][j] <= '9') {
                    exploreDP(0, i, j, i, j);
                }

        List<List<Integer>> graph = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> E = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(210, 0));
        List<Integer> H = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(210, 0));
        int[][] C = new int[210][210];
        int[][] pN = new int[11][11];

        for (int[] row : C)
            Arrays.fill(row, 0);
        for (int[] row : pN)
            Arrays.fill(row, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                reachable[i][j][i][j] = false;

        // Initialize graph with a dummy start node
        graph.add(new ArrayList<>());

        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++) {
                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
                    for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                        for (int nt = 0; nt <= t; nt++) {
                            reachable[i1][j1][i2][j2] |= visitedDP[nt][i1][j1][i2][j2];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++) {
                if (gridA[i1][j1] > '0' && gridA[i1][j1] <= '9') {
                    int k = graph.size();
                    graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
                    int val = gridA[i1][j1] - '0';
                    E.set(k, val);
                    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
                        for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                            if (gridB[i2][j2] > '0' && gridB[i2][j2] <= '9') {
                                if (reachable[i2][j2][i1][j1]) {
                                    int _k;
                                    if (pN[i2][j2] == 0) {
                                        _k = graph.size();
                                        graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
                                        pN[i2][j2] = _k;
                                    } else {
                                        _k = pN[i2][j2];
                                    }
                                    graph.get(k).add(_k);
                                    graph.get(_k).add(k);
                                    C[k][_k] = 10000;
                                    C[_k][k] = 0;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                if (gridB[i2][j2] > '0' && gridB[i2][j2] <= '9' && pN[i2][j2] > 0) {
                    int _k = pN[i2][j2];
                    graph.get(_k).add(0);
                    C[_k][0] = gridB[i2][j2] - '0';
                    C[0][_k] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize H array
        for (int i = 0; i < graph.size(); i++) {
            H.set(i, 0);
        }

        int[] Earr = new int[graph.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < Earr.length; i++) {
            Earr[i] = E.get(i);
        }

        int[] F = new int[210][210];
        for (int[] row : F)
            Arrays.fill(row, 0);

        // Implementing the max flow (Dinic's algorithm)
        while (true) {
            boolean allDone = true;
            for (int i = 1; i < graph.size(); i++) {
                while (Earr[i] > 0) {
                    boolean progress = true;
                    int minH = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                    for (int jIdx : graph.get(i)) {
                        if (C[i][jIdx] - Earr[i] > 0 && H.get(i) == H.get(jIdx) + 1) {
                            int delta = Math.min(C[i][jIdx] - Earr[i], Earr[i]);
                            F[i][jIdx] += delta;
                            F[jIdx][i] -= delta;
                            Earr[i] -= delta;
                            Earr[jIdx] += delta;
                            progress = false;
                            allDone = false;
                            if (Earr[i] == 0) break;
                        }
                        minH = Math.min(minH, H.get(jIdx));
                    }
                    if (H.get(i) != minH + 1 && minH != Integer.MAX_VALUE)
                        H.set(i, minH + 1);
                    if (progress) break;
                }
            }
            if (allDone) break;
        }

        System.out.println(Earr[0]);
    }
}
